decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three months from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank or rear walls of the detached outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 33 Harvard Road, Isleworth. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
description: Retention of existing outbuilding to be used as a garden store, including demolition of part of outbuilding in rear garden of existing house
